outcome: pain perception during local anesthetic injection (LAI)
cohort: 44 pregnant women scheduled for cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Pre-local anesthetic injection (LAI) high-frequency vitality index (HFVI) and analgesia nociception index (ANI) values were not associated with pain perception during LAI during cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Pre-LAI HFVI/ANI values were not associated with pain perception during LAI specifically during cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Before local anesthetic injection (LAI) during spinal anesthesia for cesarean delivery.
